english: Let $\theta=\tan^{-1}\dfrac13$, where $\tan^{-1}$ takes values in $\left(-\dfrac\pi2,\dfrac\pi2\right)$. For each positive integer $n$, let $E_n=\displaystyle\sum_{k=1}^{n}\tan(k\theta)\tan\big((k+1)\theta\big)$ and $F_n=\displaystyle\sum_{k=1}^{n}k(k+1)$. Then the value of $\dfrac{E_4}{F_4}$ is ______.
hindi: माना $\theta=\tan^{-1}\dfrac13$ है, जहाँ $\tan^{-1}$ के मान $\left(-\dfrac\pi2,\dfrac\pi2\right)$ में हैं। प्रत्येक धनात्मक पूर्णांक $n$ के लिए माना $E_n=\displaystyle\sum_{k=1}^{n}\tan(k\theta)\tan\big((k+1)\theta\big)$ तथा $F_n=\displaystyle\sum_{k=1}^{n}k(k+1)$ है। तब $\dfrac{E_4}{F_4}$ का मान ______ है।
solution_full: Let $t_k=\tan k\theta$, so $t_1=\dfrac13$. Since $\theta=(k+1)\theta-k\theta$, $\tan\theta=\dfrac{t_{k+1}-t_k}{1+t_kt_{k+1}}$, i.e. $t_kt_{k+1}=\dfrac{t_{k+1}-t_k}{\tan\theta}-1=3(t_{k+1}-t_k)-1$ (valid for $k\le4$, since $5\theta\neq\dfrac\pi2$).
For the product of linear factors: $k(k+1)=\dfrac{k(k+1)(k+2)-(k-1)k(k+1)}{3}$ telescopes to $F_n=\dfrac{n(n+1)(n+2)}{3}$, so $F_4=\dfrac{4\cdot5\cdot6}{3}=40$.
originality_note: New: the sum of products of tangents of consecutive multiples is put beside the sum of products of consecutive integers; both telescope, one through tan(A - B) and one through the product-of-linear-factors identity, and 5 theta passing pi/2 makes E_4 negative (way 5: two parallel 'consecutive product' telescopings). Closest known: the identity tan A tan B = (tan B - tan A)/tan(B - A) - 1 used with theta = pi/(2n+1) type angles. Different because: theta = tan^{-1}(1/3) is not a rational multiple of pi, so the tangents must be computed exactly by addition formulas, and the sign change past pi/2 is a trap.
